upload.label: Brugertoken
help: Opret en ny app fra bunden i dit workspace på api.slack.com/apps.

Tilføj disse user token scopes under OAuth & Permissions: channels:read, groups:read, im:read, mpim:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, search:read, users:read, users:read.email, chat:write, im:write, reactions:write. Installer den så (din workspace-admin skal måske godkende den).
Kopiér User OAuth Token (starter med xoxp-) og indsæt den her.
